<thought>We need a retrosynthetic template that breaks a carboxylic acid (C‑O bond) and forms an amide (C‑N bond). We'll search the template catalog for templates that break the "carboxylic_acid" functional group and form an "amide", with a C‑O bond broken and a C‑N bond formed.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["carboxylic_acid"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amide"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-N"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
